title: scpm user config
description: The user config file as written.

credentials.description:
Credentials, matched against a repository's (or its mirror's) URL by scheme, host and
port; a path narrows the match to URLs under it.

mirrors.description: Mirrors, applied at download time and never recorded in the lock.

proxy.description: The proxy for every download. Set, it replaces `HTTPS_PROXY`, `HTTP_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY`.

resolverMirror.description:
A base URL to download the resolver sidecar's own jars from instead of the scpm GitHub
release; each jar's file name is appended. Every jar stays pinned by the sha256 built into
scpm, and no credentials are sent, so it must allow anonymous access.

CredentialEntry.description:
`{url, token}` (bearer) or `{url, user, password}` (basic auth). Each value is `env:VAR`,
`file:PATH` (`~` is the home directory) or the value itself.

allowInsecureCredentials.description:
Send credentials to this mirror although it is `http://` and plain HTTP exposes them: to
exactly its scheme, host and port, for the repositories reached through it, and nowhere
else. Without it, credentials go to a mirror only over HTTPS.

mirrorOf.description: Repository ids, URL prefixes, or `*` for every repository.

noProxy.description:
Hosts reached directly: a name also covers its subdomains (`.example.com` or
`example.com`), `*` covers every host.
